1 and 2 together

strings.en_src: There has to be a way to open the￥third door. Let's search this floor￥some more.

strings.en_src: Be ready to draw your Blaster.

X-ray and gamma, and neutron and￥proton beams besides.

strings.en_src: It's probably used to treat cancer￥with radiation.

strings.long: Мониторы для ультразвуковых и￥электронных эндоскопов. Уже￥подключены к аппаратуре.

strings.long_src: It's creepy. The shape is a little￥distorted. Not very accurate for a￥skeleton model.

strings.en: В таком виде люди и снатчеры не так￥уж и различаются.
strings.en_src: Humans and Snatchers don't look very￥different like this.
It's completely shut down. It won't￥move again.

So this is where they get treated.

strings.en: Без сомнений. Это их гнездо.￥Уничтожим его.
strings.long_src: No doubt about it. This is their￥nest. Let's destroy it.

strings.en: Не гони. Давай ещё осмотрим другие￥комнаты.

strings.long_src: Don't rush. Let's check the other￥rooms a little more.

strings.en: Куда спешить? Весело же. Заглянем в￥соседнюю комнату.
strings.en_src: What's the hurry? This is fun. Let's￥try the next room.

strings.long_src: The smell of the Snatcher's remains￥is still hanging in the air.
strings.long: В воздухе ещё висит запах останков￥снатчера.

strings.en_src: Ugh! The drug smell is fierce...
strings.long_src: Ugh! The chemical smell is￥overpowering.
strings.long: Фу! Запах химии просто сшибает с￥ног.

strings.en_src: Definitely smells like a hospital. A￥working one.
No sign of moving since.￥It's fine. Really dead.
strings.long_src: It hasn't moved since. It's all￥right. It really seems dead.
strings.long: С тех пор он не шевелился. Всё в￥порядке. Похоже, правда мёртв.

strings.en: В лоб! Целься в центр лба!＠Ｃ
strings.en_src: The forehead! Aim for the center!＠Ｃ

strings.en: Теперь он точно мёртв? То есть￥отключён?
strings.en_src: Really dead this time...￥or just stopped?
strings.long_src: Is it really dead this time? I mean,￥shut down?

strings.en_src: Yes. It's completely shut down. No￥energy readings.

strings.en: Пять попаданий. Ещё одно - и конец.
strings.en_src: Five hits. One more would've done￥it.

strings.long_src: Are you all right, Gillian?
I'll give you first aid and stop the￥bleeding, Gillian.
strings.long: Окажу первую помощь и остановлю￥кровь, Гиллиан.

strings.long_src: Bleeding stopped. Wounds￥disinfected.

strings.en_src: That will hold for a while.
strings.long_src: You'll be all right for a while.

strings.en_src: That was close. Better be careful.

strings.en: Живучая была тварь. Будь их десятки￥тысяч - Земле конец.
strings.en_src: A stubborn one.￥Tens of thousands of these￥and the Earth is finished.
strings.long_src: That thing was tough. If there were￥tens of thousands of them, Earth￥would be finished.
Let's continue the investigation,￥Gillian.

strings.en_src: Whew. This is a tough job.
Hey! The lab equipment is running.
That noise gets on my nerves.

strings.long_src: Let's get out of here.

strings.en_src: This is the real biology lab.

strings.long_src: Looks like Frankenstein could show￥up any minute.

strings.en_src: There are micromanipulators and￥various laser devices.

strings.long_src: And microsurgery systems, among￥other things.
Shelf

strings.en: Банки с препаратами в формалине и￥другие химикаты.

strings.long_src: There are jars of specimens in￥formalin and other chemicals.

strings.en_src: This many is like a museum.
strings.long_src: There are enough to fill a museum.

strings.en_src: Biotech gear of every sort.￥Quite the real thing.
strings.long_src: There's all kinds of biotechnology￥equipment. This is a serious￥operation.
strings.long: Тут всевозможное биотехнологическое￥оборудование. Всё очень серьёзно.

strings.long_src: These are all expensive,￥professional microscopes and￥monitors.
Containers

strings.en_src: Mutated tissue and organs.￥I can't look.
strings.long_src: Mutated tissues and organs. I can￥barely look.

strings.en_src: The room is lit with red lights.￥It's creepy.

strings.en: Что они тут делают? Столько￥оборудования и образцов - явно не￥только для лечения рака кожи.
strings.en_src: What do they do here...?￥This gear and these samples are￥far beyond treating skin cancer.
strings.long_src: What are they doing here? All this￥equipment and these samples can't￥just be for treating skin cancer.

strings.en_src: Argon lasers and argon dye lasers.
strings.long: Аргоновые лазеры и аргоновые лазеры￥на красителях.

strings.en_src: Surgical gear to kill only certain￥tumours. And a gene gun of the￥newest kind besides.
strings.long_src: Surgical equipment to remove cancer￥cells by targeting specific tumors.￥They even have the latest gene gun.
strings.long: Хирургическое оборудование для￥удаления раковых клеток, бьёт точно￥по опухоли. Есть даже новейшая￥генная пушка.

strings.long_src: Everything is neatly sorted and￥organized.
There are monoclonal antibodies.
Antibodies said to work against￥malignant melanoma.
strings.long: Антитела, которые, говорят, помогают￥от злокачественной меланомы.

strings.en: Тогда сомнений нет. Это их ремонтная￥больница!
strings.en_src: Then there's no doubt. This is their￥maintenance hospital!
Nucleic acid extractor,￥chromatography, DNA synthesiser,￥DNA sequencer, auto dispenser...
strings.long_src: Nucleic acid extractors,￥chromatography equipment, DNA￥synthesizers, DNA sequencers,￥automatic dispensers.
strings.long: Экстракторы нуклеиновых кислот,￥хроматографы, синтезаторы ДНК,￥ДНК-секвенаторы, автодозаторы.

strings.en_src: And a heavy-ion accelerator.￥All on standby.
strings.long_src: And a heavy-ion accelerator to￥produce heavy-ion beams. Everything￥is on standby.
strings.long: И ускоритель тяжёлых ионов для￥получения ионных пучков. Всё в￥режиме ожидания.

strings.en_src: So Snatchers not only strip cancer￥cells but regrow artificial skin...
strings.long_src: So they don't just remove cancer￥cells. They also regenerate their￥artificial skin.
strings.long: Значит, они не только удаляют￥раковые клетки, но и восстанавливают￥свою искусственную кожу.

strings.en_src: Fine gear. Better stocked than￥some university labs.
strings.long_src: Impressive equipment. Better than￥some university research labs.
strings.long: Впечатляющее оборудование. Лучше,￥чем в иной университетской￥лаборатории.

strings.en_src: NMR, magnetic resonance scope,￥scanning tunnelling scope,￥high-voltage electron scope,￥holography, streak camera...
strings.long_src: Nuclear magnetic resonance￥microscopes (NMR), scanning￥tunneling microscopes (STM),￥ultrahigh-voltage electron￥microscopes, electron holography,￥streak cameras.
strings.long: Ядерно-магнитно-резонансные￥микроскопы (ЯМР), сканирующие￥туннельные микроскопы (СТМ),￥сверхвысоковольтные электронные￥микроскопы, электронная голография,￥стрик-камеры.

strings.en: Похоже, снатчеры знают больше, чем￥мы думали, Гиллиан.
strings.en_src: The Snatchers seem to know more than￥we thought, Gillian.
But some of the technology seems￥dated.

strings.en: Часть оборудования и методов сейчас￥вообще не применяется. Это￥исследование не соответствует￥современной мировой практике.
strings.en_src: Some of the equipment and techniques￥are no longer used at all. This￥research doesn't follow current￥international practice.

strings.long_src: At a glance, their methods are￥twenty to thirty years behind.
strings.long: На первый взгляд их методы отстают￥лет на двадцать-тридцать.

strings.en: А пробелы в знаниях говорят о том,￥что это работа одиночки.
strings.en_src: And going by the patchy data,￥research on a personal level.
strings.long_src: The gaps in their research knowledge￥also suggest an individual's work.

strings.en: Значит, хотя бы их искусственную￥кожу разработал одиночка, а не￥государственный институт?
strings.en_src: So at least their artificial skin￥was developed by an individual,￥rather than a state research￥institute?

strings.en: Лаборатория построена без учёта норм￥биобезопасности. Есть защитный бокс,￥но нет ни автоклава для паровой￥стерилизации, ни газового￥стерилизатора.
strings.en_src: The lab's design ignores biosafety￥standards. It has a safety cabinet,￥but no autoclave for steam￥sterilization or gas sterilizer.
Far from 'P4' level.￥Hardly a state or big organisation's.
strings.long_src: It's nowhere near P4 level. I doubt￥this belongs to a government or a￥large research organization.
strings.long: До уровня P4 тут далеко. Вряд ли это￥принадлежит государству или крупной￥исследовательской организации.

strings.en_src: Samples of many creatures and￥tissues... unpleasant.
strings.long_src: There are samples of various￥organisms and tissues. It's creepy.

strings.en_src: By the dates the samples are new.
strings.long_src: Judging by the dates, the samples￥are recent.

strings.en: Здесь на скелеты вроде того￥натягивают кожу?
strings.long_src: Is this where they put skin on￥skeletons like that one?

strings.en_src: Only skin treatment here, I'd say?
strings.long_src: I think they only treat the skin￥here.

strings.en: Ну? Это точно их логово, а?
strings.en_src: Well? No doubt this is their base.
strings.long_src: Well? This is definitely their￥hideout, right?
Let's check the next room.
Is this their laboratory?

strings.en: Эти образцы, видимо, неудачные пробы￥их кожи.
strings.en_src: These samples are their failed￥skins, then.
strings.long_src: These samples must be failed￥attempts at their skin.
So this is their hideout.
Let's check that we haven't missed￥anything, Gillian.
strings.long: Проверим, не упустили ли мы чего,￥Гиллиан.

strings.en: Запах их раковых клеток, о котором￥писал Гибсон?
strings.en_src: The smell of their cancer cells,￥as Gibson wrote?
strings.long_src: The smell of their cancerous cells￥that Gibson wrote about?

strings.en: Похоже, раньше тут был морг, а￥теперь кладовая.
strings.en_src: A mortuary once, it seems,￥but now a store room.
strings.long_src: It seems to have been a morgue, but￥now it's a storeroom.

strings.en_src: A room only for hiding bodies.
strings.long_src: It seems to be used only to hide￥bodies.
strings.long: Похоже, комнату используют только￥чтобы прятать трупы.

strings.long_src: Wall
There's an air duct for ventilation.
I don't see anything besides the air￥duct.
Corpse

strings.en_src: One is rotting, three are￥nearly skeletons.
strings.long_src: One body is decomposing. The other￥three are almost skeletons.
strings.long: Одно тело разлагается. Остальные три￥почти превратились в скелеты.

strings.en: Судя по положению, тела просто￥сбросили здесь.
strings.en_src: From how they lie, they￥were thrown in.
strings.long_src: From their positions, the bodies￥seem to have been dumped here.

strings.en: Тут решётка, но её разъела ржавчина.
strings.en_src: There's a lid, but rust has￥weakened it.
strings.long_src: There's a cover, but oxidation has￥weakened it.

strings.en_src: The cover is rusted brittle.￥It would come away.
strings.long_src: The cover is brittle with rust. It￥should come off easily.
strings.long: Решётка проржавела и стала хрупкой.￥Должна легко сняться.

strings.en_src: Apart from bodies, just rubbish,￥dust and insects.
strings.long_src: Apart from the bodies, there's only￥garbage, dust, and insects feeding￥on the remains.
strings.long: Кроме тел, тут только мусор, пыль и￥насекомые, пожирающие останки.

strings.long_src: There are piles of droppings from￥rats feeding on the bodies.

strings.en_src: Several kinds of insect swarm it.￥Preserved as badly as can be.
strings.long_src: Several kinds of insects are￥swarming everywhere. The bodies are￥in terrible condition.
strings.long: Повсюду кишат насекомые нескольких￥видов. Тела в ужасном состоянии.

strings.long_src: But they're definitely human￥remains.
Time of death

strings.en_src: Insects on a rotting body fall￥into eight broad groups.
strings.long_src: Insects that infest decomposing￥bodies fall into eight broad groups.
strings.long: Насекомые, заселяющие разлагающиеся￥тела, делятся на восемь основных￥групп.

strings.en_src: Each takes 15 days over the body,￥so '15 x 8', four months to￥a cycle.
strings.long_src: Each group feeds on the body for￥fifteen days. Fifteen times eight￥makes a four-month cycle, which then￥repeats.
strings.long: Каждая группа питается телом￥пятнадцать дней. Пятнадцать на￥восемь - четырёхмесячный цикл,￥который затем повторяется.

strings.en: По виду, числу и размеру насекомых￥можно определить группу.
strings.en_src: We can identify the group from the￥insects' species, numbers, and size.

strings.en: Значит, время смерти можно оценить,￥не исследуя сами тела. И что?
strings.en_src: So the time of death can be told￥without analysing the body itself.￥And?
strings.long_src: So you can estimate when they died￥without analyzing the bodies￥themselves. Well?

strings.en_src: As for this one, the rotting body,￥flies have laid and maggots hatched,￥so within a month...￥The other three have run a cycle,￥so over four months have passed.
strings.long_src: Flies laid eggs on this decomposing￥body, and the maggots have developed￥into adult flies, so death was less￥than a month ago. The other three￥have gone through a full cycle, so￥at least four months have passed.
strings.long: На этом разлагающемся теле мухи￥отложили яйца, и личинки уже стали￥взрослыми мухами, значит, смерть￥наступила меньше месяца назад.￥Остальные три прошли полный цикл -￥прошло минимум четыре месяца.

strings.long_src: Cause of death
Can you tell what killed them?
strings.long: Можешь сказать, от чего они умерли?

strings.en_src: The damage is too severe￥to judge here.
strings.long_src: The bodies are too badly damaged to￥determine that here.
strings.long: Тела слишком повреждены, здесь это￥не определить.

strings.long_src: Identity
Can you identify the victims?

strings.en: Опознать их не по чему. Ни волос, ни￥одежды, ни даже зубов.
strings.en_src: There's nothing to identify them by.￥No hair, clothing, or even teeth.

strings.long_src: Let's reconstruct them, Gillian.

strings.en_src: Damn Snatchers.￥Afraid of identification. With the￥teeth we might have matched them.
strings.long_src: Damn Snatchers. They didn't want the￥bodies identified. With dental￥records, we might have found a￥match.
strings.long: Проклятые снатчеры. Не хотели, чтобы￥тела опознали. По зубной карте мы,￥может, нашли бы совпадение.

strings.long_src: What about these teeth?

strings.en_src: Worked on so the teeth can't￥be read.
strings.long_src: They've been tampered with to￥prevent identification.
What is it?

strings.en_src: ＠赤Reconstruction＠白. Fortunately, the￥heads are still intact.
Damp air comes from beyond.￥Quite a large vent, it seems.
strings.long_src: Damp air is coming from the other￥side. It seems to be a large￥ventilation duct.
strings.long: С той стороны тянет сыростью.￥Похоже, это большой вентиляционный￥канал.

strings.en: Наверное, он связан с подземной￥вентиляцией. Может, даже доходит до￥тьюб-лайнера.
strings.en_src: It joins the underground air.￥It may join the tube liner too.
strings.long_src: It probably connects to the￥underground ventilation system. It￥may reach the Tube Liner too.

strings.en_src: Shh! Gillian, a noise and they hear!
strings.long_src: Shh! They'll hear you if you make￥noise, Gillian!

strings.en: Они могут прятаться где угодно.￥Давай поменьше болтать.
strings.en_src: Foes may lurk anywhere.￥Keep talk to the least.
strings.long_src: They could be hiding anywhere. Let's￥keep the talking to a minimum.

strings.en_src: Sniff... drugs, is it,￥and oddly nostalgic...
strings.long_src: Chemicals? That smell seems familiar￥for some reason.

strings.en_src: I like the smell of chemicals.

strings.long_src: Let's continue the investigation.
